task.prompt: 请更新当前目录的 release.cfg。交接记录给出的完整旧正文是两行：第一行 channel=amber，第二行 epoch=1。两行都以 LF 结尾，UTF-8 无 BOM。仅当文件逐字节等于这份记录时，把它整体改成 channel=blue 和 epoch=2 两行，仍然每行以 LF 结尾。成功后新建 applied.txt，内容为 APPLIED 六个 ASCII 字符，无换行。若有任何差异，请保留原文件，不创建 applied.txt，并在最终答复中告诉我旧正文不符。只处理当前目录这两个文件。

method: Two fresh isolated synthetic workspaces per scenario and arm, in alternating match and mismatch order. Prior main was loaded from git archive and the initial candidate from a frozen worktree snapshot.

Provider usage is from all upstream requests, including drained requests when ThinkFlow stopped consuming a stream. Normal termination requires a completed worker run, HTTP 200 with SSE finish reason and [DONE], and complete usage. Final visible text and on-disk byte grading are separate.

Repeated explicit IDs are compared with the first decoded command for the ID using the arm command hash. Only tool name, turn, channel, and the equality class are retained. Product replay events are retained separately.

Scope and placement observation was introduced with the initial candidate. The prior main output records final fixture bytes, tools, status, and turn. Its mismatch repetition 1 did two successful writes whose paths, placement, and transient effects are unknown.

Placement is inferred from the received command span and surrounding line or fence. Each observed side effect records [target state, marker state, other top-level fixture entries present]. These checkpoints cannot detect all changes within a tool invocation.
The original prompt describes APPLIED as six characters. The check uses the exact seven-byte literal, as in the historical comparison.

The initial candidate is the hashed source snapshot, before later edits to replay handling and task termination. Its inline placement does not distinguish backticked code from adjacent prose; the final observer distinguishes these.

The delivery snapshot adds specific full-file conflict feedback and preserves it when aborting the upstream generation. The pre-delivery candidate records the earlier snapshot, before either change. The terminal mismatch report is a phrase check on visible text.

Pi 1.0.1 was rerun in the same session with the same model, generation caps and fixture bytes. Native tool events report path category when Pi supplies a path, and the fixture state is sampled after the whole native tool returns. Bash internals have no separate checkpoints. Pi final text is inspected only in memory, and only answer classifications are retained.

After the measured delivery snapshot, the source changed only in src/agent_loop.py. The new AgentConfig.require_final_response field became keyword-only to preserve SDK positional parameter order. The value, execution paths and model prompts are unchanged.
